volunteerExperiences.description:
During this holiday season, we’re participating in their Holiday Program by being part of their Family Sharing Program. Through this program, families and seniors that don’t have the means to receive gifts or have a proper holiday meal are “adopted” and provided for. Already, the Samaritan House has been able to give out 1,750 gifts to children along with providing over 1,200 families with food.

Read more about it here, http://bit.ly/1HpnCWx
